name: The Operations Loadout
tagline: 10 AI staff for quoting, scheduling, job management, and admin.
heroHeadline: Stop losing jobs because your quote was late or your follow-up was missing.
heroSubhead: The complete Claude AI setup for tradespeople and service businesses — beginner-friendly, live in under 30 minutes.
problem: You're spending evenings writing quotes that should take 10 minutes — and losing jobs to whoever replies first.
Follow-up after a quote? It rarely happens. You're already on the next job before you remember.
One late message, one missed follow-up, one sloppy proposal — and the customer goes with someone else.
Every hour on admin is an hour you're not billing. And you're doing a lot of admin.
shift: What if your quote was drafted before you finished the walkthrough? What if a follow-up went out automatically two days after you sent it? What if your operation looked as professional as a company ten times your size?

whatsInside.description: Draft professional quotes from job notes in minutes. Faster response means more conversions — especially against other one-person operations.
Automated follow-up sequences post-quote. Polite, professional, in your voice — without you having to remember.

whatsInside.outcome: Look more professional on every touchpoint
whatsInside.description: Customer-facing messages, job summaries, invoice notes — all sharp and on-brand, every time.

bonuses: Quick-Start Setup Guide (PDF) — running in under 30 minutes, with screenshots
30-Day Prompt Cheat Sheet — the exact phrases for trades tasks
5 Quote and Follow-Up Templates — ready to use on your next job
bumpDescription: 15 additional templates for supplier negotiation, complaint handling, seasonal promotions, review request sequences, and subcontractor communication.
premiumDescription: A 30-minute 1-on-1 Zoom call. We install and configure everything together, customized for your specific trade and workflow.

faqs.q: Do I need to know anything about AI?
faqs.a: No. Setup guide with screenshots. Most people are running in under 30 minutes.

faqs.q: What trades does this work for?
faqs.a: HVAC, electrical, plumbing, landscaping, cleaning, construction, auto service — any trade or service business that quotes jobs and follows up with customers.
